audit.why: The mirror audit (tryndamere vs vayne) already aligned all seven rows to the packet chart; leaving two rows on 'Skill' here would contradict the mirror and be overwritten.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 and First item flipped to Vayne in both layers, ratings 5/10 -> 8/10, and the whys rewritten to say why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The First-item spike text named only Blade of the Ruined King and never the anti-heal timing that actually decides the extended trade.
audit.why: Bloodlust (Q) heals off Fury on a flat 12s cooldown; without Grievous Wounds a won trade is refunded before the next one.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why and whys[5] now pair the item spike with Grievous Wounds.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d (titled 'Anti-heal his crit healing') contained a duplicated trading line instead of anti-heal content, and dontsFull[0].d/dontsFull[1].d were generic with no cooldowns or the terrain condition.
audit.why: Condemn (E) knocks back and only stuns on terrain collision (20/18/16/14/12s); Spinning Slash (E) is his sole gap-closer at 12/11/10/9/8s and 0 cost.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d with the real cooldowns, the wall condition and the Grievous Wounds requirement.

audit.why: Spinning Slash's cooldown is already the tracked window throughout; now stated numerically.
Executioner's Calling is already listed early in report[8].t, which matches the needs-antiheal finding.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Spinning Slash's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your control window: Spinning Slash is down 12s at rank 1 and he has no ultimate yet, so trade on its cooldown and bank the small leads.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you freely kite and deny his crit windows before his ultimate exists.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you kite freely: Spinning Slash is 12s and Undying Rage does not exist.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Spinning Slash's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King plus Executioner's Calling out-races Bloodlust's healing — force fights once both complete.

edits.before: First item your true-damage DPS out-races his crit trades while you kite.
edits.after: First item, Silver Bolts true damage plus Grievous Wounds out-races Bloodlust.

edits.before: Tryndamere wastes Spinning Slash — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Bloodlust (Q) heals off his Fury every 12s — buy Executioner's Calling early.

edits.before: That is Tryndamere's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Condemn him as he lands: Spinning Slash (E) is 12s at rank 1, and a wall stuns him.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Without Grievous Wounds, Bloodlust refunds every trade you just won.
